summary: Learn event and conference management with budgets, run sheets, risk registers, and hybrid workflows. Train your team to plan and deliver with confidence.
lede: Conference and event management training helps professionals who coordinate business gatherings plan, deliver and review them with a clear process. It covers defining event objectives, building budgets and timelines, comparing venues and suppliers, coordinating registration and live delivery, managing event risks, and evaluating outcomes through feedback and post-event reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate business events and need a structured way to manage planning, execution, and review. It is suitable for people working across event delivery, conference logistics, venue operations, sponsorship, marketing, and corporate communications. Event Coordinators managing planning timelines and supplier follow-up. Conference Managers overseeing agendas, speakers, and delegate logistics. Event Operations Supervisors controlling on-site delivery and staffing. Venue Managers coordinating room setup, flow, and service readiness. Sponsorship Managers tracking partner value and activation deliverables. Corporate Communications Specialists supporting promotion and attendee messaging. Marketing Executives aligning event campaigns with attendance targets. Logistics Coordinators managing transport, equipment, and vendor schedules. Project Managers handling event budgets, milestones, and risks. Administrative Officers supporting bookings, documentation, and post-event closeout.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and familiarity with basic event coordination documents such as agendas, booking forms, or vendor lists. Bringing a current or recent event case is helpful, especially if you want to workshop your own budget, timeline, venue shortlist, or risk register.
